messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a complete, playable 3D cowboy horse game in the existing workspace.

## Requirements
- Desert setting with cowboy and horse gameplay.
- Include different selectable horse options.
- Combine pet simulation and sports/trail-riding gameplay.
- Include music and sound effects.
- Support desktop and mobile touch controls.
- Save and inspect a screenshot during implementation.

## Decisions
- Used a polished 3D scene with Three.js, atmospheric UI, stable care actions, free riding, and a timed canyon trail race.
- Assumed a browser-based single-page game with no external assets beyond fonts and Three.js CDN.

## Work State
### Completed
- Built the full UI in `index.html`.
- Created responsive visual styling in `style.css`.
- Implemented the 3D desert ranch, terrain, structures, cacti, rocks, horse riders, camera, animations, trail gates, and barrel props in `game.js`.
- Implemented three horse selections, care actions, coins, levels, stamina/bond/spirit stats, free ride mode, canyon race, generated music, and sound effects.
- Added desktop keyboard controls, Shift galloping, R free ride, Escape race cancellation, and mobile directional buttons.
- Started a local server and captured a viewport JPEG for visual verification.

### Active
- Gameplay and visual polish are complete enough for play; no active task remains.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. (none)

## Relevant Files
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html`: Main game structure and overlays.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/style.css`: Complete desktop/mobile visual design.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/game.js`: Three.js scene and gameplay implementation.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/screenshots/ranch.jpg`: Latest captured viewport screenshot.

## Important Context
- The game is served locally at `http://127.0.0.1:3002`.
- Browser screenshots used SwiftShader CPU software rendering.
- The latest browser verification reported only a missing `favicon.ico` 404; no gameplay code errors were reported.
